# Authrix

Authrix is a powerful AI-driven platform designed to detect AI-generated content, check for plagiarism, and "humanize" text to ensure it passes AI detection systems. 

## 🚀 Key Features

*   **AI Content Detection**: High-accuracy detection of text generated by LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, etc.).
*   **Plagiarism Checker**: Deep scans across web and academic databases to ensure content originality.
*   **AI Humanizer**: Intelligent rewriting of AI-generated text to improve readability and bypass detection.
*   **Usage Tracking**: Real-time monitoring of API usage and credit management.

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

### Backend
*   **Framework**: [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) (Python 3.12+)
*   **Database**: PostgreSQL (via [SQLAlchemy](https://www.sqlalchemy.org/) & [Asyncpg](https://magicstack.github.io/asyncpg/))
*   **Migrations**: [Alembic](https://alembic.sqlalchemy.org/)
*   **Validation**: [Pydantic v2](https://docs.pydantic.dev/)
*   **Security**: JWT Authentication (JOSE), Bcrypt hashing, Rate Limiting.

### Frontend
*   **Framework**: [Next.js 16](https://nextjs.org/) (React 19)
*   **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS 4](https://tailwindcss.com/), Framer Motion, Lucide icons.
*   **State Management**: [Zustand](https://zustand-demo.pmnd.rs/)
*   **UI Components**: Base UI, Shadcn, and custom premium components.

## 📂 Project Structure

```text
Authrix/
├── backend/                # FastAPI Application
│   ├── alembic/            # Database migrations
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── api/            # API endpoints (auth, analyze, humanize, usage)
│   │   ├── core/           # Config, Security, Rate Limiting
│   │   ├── db/             # Database models, session, and operations
│   │   ├── schemas/        # Pydantic models for request/response
│   │   ├── services/       # Core business logic (AI engines, processing)
│   │   ├── utils/          # Helper functions and validators
│   │   └── main.py         # Entry point
│   ├── requirements.txt    # Python dependencies
│   └── setup_db.py         # DB initialization script
├── frontend/               # Next.js Application
│   ├── public/             # Static assets
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── app/            # App router (Pages and Layouts)
│   │   ├── components/     # Reusable UI components
│   │   ├── lib/            # Shared utilities and API clients
│   │   ├── stores/         # State management (Zustand)
│   │   └── types/          # TypeScript interfaces/types
│   ├── package.json        # Frontend dependencies
│   └── tailwind.config.ts  # Theme configuration
└── README.md
```

## ⚙️ Getting Started

### Backend Setup
1. `cd backend`
2. `python -m venv venv`
3. `venv\Scripts\activate` (Windows) or `source venv/bin/activate` (macOS/Linux)
4. `pip install -r requirements.txt`
5. Configure `.env` from `.env.example`
6. `uvicorn app.main:app --reload`

### Frontend Setup
1. `cd frontend`
2. `npm install`
3. `npm run dev`
